verdict.rationale: The docs only establish that Teams has channels containing conversations and messages (creatable via Graph). Community reports imply channel threading exists but call it hard to follow and poorly designed, and say channel notifications are easy to miss, which undercuts efficient catch-up. Nothing documents named topics or thread-organized catch-up. Missing for 10: first-party docs on channel threading or topic naming, any catch-up or unread-summary capability, and positive hands-on corroboration that threading aids catching up.
